hookups.source: https://destateparks.com/park/cape-henlopen/ ('The campground offers water, 30-, 50-, and 100-amp electric hook-ups', snapped down to 50) + ReserveAmerica site list (all 120 standard sites list 50 amp and water; C17, C19 and C21 list full hookups), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 120 standard RV sites in loops A-F (all with water and electric, three with full hookups) plus 43 tent-only sites, besides 12 cabins. Eleven pull-throughs of 90-128 ft in loops C, D and E; back-ins mostly 35 ft, with about 30 listed at only 15 ft. Roads are narrow, slide-outs are not allowed on even-numbered sites in loop A, and the park advises booking a site longer than the rig.

sites.source: https://delawarestateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cape-henlopen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=DE&parkId=360108 (site list, all 177 units; alerts on narrow roads and loop A slide-outs) + https://destateparks.com/park/cape-henlopen/ ('pull-through sites'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Bathhouse with restrooms and showers, camp store, campground laundry. Site water in March and November depends on the weather; a frost-free spigot stays at the dump station.

facilities.source: https://destateparks.com/park/cape-henlopen/ (Campsite Amenities: Bathhouse, Camp Store, Campground Laundry Facilities, Drinking Water, Dump Station, Restrooms, Showers) + ReserveAmerica alert on winter water, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Park page: 'Two-night minimum stay required on weekends'; 'Some holiday weekends require a minimum stay of three nights (Friday through Sunday)'; 'Reserve up to 14 nights'; 'Reserve up to one (1) year in advance'. All family campsites are reservable and site-specific. One vehicle per site gets the free entry pass; other vehicles pay the entrance fee.

booking.source: https://destateparks.com/park/cape-henlopen/ (RV Camping: Reservations list; 'Reservations may be made up to one year in advance of arrival date'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Fees stand ($35-$53 base, x1.25 non-resident, $4 fee; booking table ranges agree) and year-round season ('Open year-round at select sites'). Added 50-amp electric (park says up to 100 amp) with water, 3 full-hookup sites, 163 campsites with 11 pull-throughs, showers/laundry/camp store/dump/water, and the park's booking rules: 1-year window, 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max. Not stated: same-day cutoff, fcfs, a reliable max rig length.
